summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly, with correct usage of awaiting the asynchronous assertion. The test case ID is preserved in the title. However, the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be too specific or inferred and there is only a weak assertion to verify navigation by matching part of the URL, which may not fully guarantee the correct product detail page is shown.

issues.description: Selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be too specific or guessed. Hardcoded data-test attribute may not be stable if the product ID changes.
issues.recommendation: Use a selector strategy that is more robust or data-driven to identify products dynamically.

issues.description: The URL assertion only checks if URL contains 'product' which may not guarantee the exact product detail page opened.
issues.recommendation: Enhance the assertion by verifying presence of key product detail elements or verifying the full expected URL.

recommendations: Consider expanding assertions to verify specific product information on the product detail page for stronger validation.
Consider parameterizing or dynamically retrieving product selectors for better reusability.
